metric: Every NOT NULL, uniqueness and row-count fact the analysis asserts about the queries of SQLSolver's Calcite, Spark, TPC-H and TPC-C pairs, checked on random databases that respect their schemas.
caveats: No labels, so only soundness is scored, not recall. Tuned on test: this track found two bugs (a subquery in the select list read as an aggregate, ROLLUP) that were fixed, and its unsupported queries (repeated output names, VALUES, grouping sets, LATERAL, parenthesised joins) were used to widen coverage. 16 queries could not be executed in DuckDB (SINGLE_VALUE, mixed-type CASE, COUNT of two columns). 2026-11-23 (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 62, the fix for issue 64): 2,669 to 2,663 claims. Six never-NULL claims are withdrawn, in four queries: each is a quotient, and MySQL returns NULL for a zero divisor (SUM(..) / COUNT(*) and expressions over it in two Calcite queries, the market share of TPC-H Q8 in two). The analysis does not use that the COUNT(*) of a group is never zero, so it now leaves those unclaimed as well. Measured on b923b93b; no claim is violated.
correctness: 0 violated claims in 40 random databases per query (and in 300 per query in a one-off stress run)
